steps.title: Rings
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as carousel.ipt.
Sketch circles diameter 79 and 83, and 156 and 159 on the XZ Plane. Extrude 20 mm.

steps.title: Hub tube
actions: Extrude the inner ring down 25.5 mm, Join.
steps.note: The tube passes down through the deck; the drive gear is pressed onto its end.

steps.title: Ribs
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Pattern panel > Circular Pattern
actions: Sketch one rib 1 thick from the inner to the outer ring. Extrude 20 mm, Join.
steps.note: Each 12 degree segment holds one dose: a press of the button turns the carousel one segment.

steps.title: Caps on the 2 blanks
actions: Sketch the two segments either side of the front rib. Extrude 1.5 mm down from the top, Join.
steps.note: The blank under the drop hole is where the carousel waits when it is filled, so no pills can fall out while the pharmacy loads it.

steps.title: Drive keys
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Pattern panel > Circular Pattern
actions: Sketch a 2 x 1.3 key inside the bottom of the hub tube. Extrude 6 mm, Join.
steps.note: The drive gear has three slots that fit these keys.
